title: Crafting Reworked
description: This is mod is made for making crafting more logical compared to normal minecraft.
body:
The goal of this mod is simple:  

Make Minecraft's crafting system feel more logical while staying true to the vanilla experience.  

✨ Vanilla Recipe Improvements  
Better stair yields.  
1 plank → 4 buttons.  
6 planks → 6 doors.  
6 planks → 6 trapdoors.  
6 planks + 1 stick → 6 signs.  
7 sticks → 6 ladders.  

🛠️ New Crafting Recipes  
Wool → String.  
Cobweb → String.  
Logs → Sticks.  
Logs → Chests.  
Clay Block → Clay Balls.  
Quartz Block → Quartz.  
Honeycomb Block → Honeycomb.  
Melon → Melon Slices.  
Skeleton Skull → Bones.  
Craftable Saddles.  
Craftable Name Tags.  
Craftable Horse Armor.  
Blue Ice → Packed Ice.  
Packed Ice → Ice.  

The idea behind every change is the same:  

Preserve materials whenever possible.  
Reduce unnecessary crafting frustration.  
Keep progression intact.  
Stay as close to vanilla as possible.  

This is only the beginning, and I'd love to hear your feedback, suggestions, and bug reports. If you think a recipe should be changed, let me know—but try to keep in mind the mod's philosophy of logical vanilla-friendly crafting.  

Thanks to everyone who decides to give Crafting Reworked a try. I hope it makes your Minecraft worlds just a little bit more satisfying to play.
